abstract: Teleperformance reported full-year 2024 revenue of EUR 10,280 million and launched over 200 new AI projects during the year. The company plans to invest up to EUR 100 million in AI-focused partnerships during 2025, signaling a strategic commitment to artificial intelligence integration in its business operations.
keyFindings: Teleperformance achieved full-year 2024 revenue of EUR 10,280 million.
The company launched over 200 new AI projects in 2024.
Teleperformance plans to invest up to EUR 100 million in AI-focused partnerships during 2025.
methodology: Not specified. Source is a corporate earnings announcement reporting annual financial results and strategic initiatives.
qualifiers: None stated. Note: This is a corporate press release with limited detail on AI project scope, definitions, or labor market impact metrics.
